settled_start_provenance.meaning: Nominal physics-v2 rest after20s home hold, zero-velocity reset; xy recentered. Provisional mass/actuators, not physically measured.

base_payload.basis: 50g provisional sum: controller product listing16g (not weighed bare board); IMU carrier10g, additional mount15g and local wires/fasteners9g are engineering estimates. Existing CAD Waveshare mounting plate already in base is not counted again. Box geometry/COM are estimated, not a collision or protected-clearance model. External tether mass is not added to links; drag model retained.

actuator_provenance.variant: 12V ST-3215-C018, user sticker identifies12VSTS3215; detailed suffix not independently measured
actuator_provenance.nominal_rationale: 1.5Nm is the lower approved provisional choice between rated and stall;4rad/s below catalog no-load. Independent box limits do not model torque-speed or thermal/current envelope. Not continuous ratings or hardware authorization.

velocity_constraint_provisional_notes.semantics: velocity_limit_sim is a joint velocity constraint. PhysX drive/contact/limit corrections can conflict; observed brief PD-opposing overspeed is provisionally accepted, not a proven physical back-drive model. No artificial clamp.
velocity_constraint_provisional_notes.monitoring: Per completed physics step before autoreset: actual per-environment caps, peak absolute joint speed, environment-time fraction over cap+0.001rad/s. Flag >1% time or estimated PD-driven overspeed sustained >=0.05s. PD sign is a proxy, not measured solver torque.
velocity_constraint_provisional_notes.unvalidated: Actuator torque-speed/thermal/back-drive properties and contact geometry remain unmeasured; numerical convergence probes do not establish hardware fidelity.

policy_rate_50hz_provenance.decision: robin, directly in the GPU session 2026-10-15 ~04:30 UTC: "change the rate of policy to 50 hz"
policy_rate_50hz_provenance.settled_starts: Same rest states (20 s home hold; rate-independent once settled), re-bound from contract 10395fc54767f4a881b9ade79d941aaa6a6d70cc6ddfc689dd8f24abbe40dbaa to the 50 Hz contract. Passive stillness at 50 Hz is re-checked by the hold batches of the next zero-training run.
policy_rate_50hz_provenance.action_delay: max_action_delay_steps stays 1 step, now 20 ms instead of 50 ms; real latency is still unmeasured.

reward_provenance.decision: robin, directly in the GPU session 2026-10-15: stop training; two portions (forward, standing up); derive standing-up from the scripted get-ups; approved "implement it and verify in sim" ~04:41 UTC.
reward_provenance.evidence: runs/getup-reward-derivation-001 (held-out scripted successes positive from 1 s; failures ~0; lying 0; flailing ~0) and runs/two-portion-reward-analysis-001 (orderings).
reward_provenance.old_terms_not_used: tilt, lateral, time, yaw, one-sided progress gate and capped side-start shaping are replaced by the two portions.

revision_002.change: Forward ground is paid only in crawling mode (after a stable upright, cos >= 0.8 for 0.5 s, until the next fall below cos 0.5).
revision_002.reason: runs/two-portion-verification-003: a failed left get-up lunged ~2 cm forward while partly tipped (max cos 0.70) and kept +0.63 forward reward after falling. Repeated half-rise/lunge/fall could have farmed forward reward without standing.
revision_002.code: Progress potential computed in float64 (GPU float32 picked different neighbours near ties, ~1e-4 in Phi).

reward_refinements_provenance.note: two-portion-002 plus: roll-based uprightness with a 45-60 deg pitch bound for the standing and forward portions (the get-up potential and crawl mode keep the acceptance cosine); lane band 10-15 cm (scripted get-ups shift the base 10-11.6 cm sideways, runs/evaluation-hybrid-001-dev-6000); world heading band 30-90 deg while upright; non-support ground contact while upright (4/s: the lowest round weight that ranks rock D above rock A in runs/gait-scores-two-portion-003); heading term REMOVED from two-portion-hybrid-002 (robin, 2026-10-16: no heading correction needed)

handover.note: Track B (#15): in half of all training episodes the hybrid scripted controller (#14) acts for a uniform random prefix (upright: 0.02-12 s of the rock-D gait; side: 0.02-6 s of settle and get-up), then the learner takes over from that state. Teacher steps are excluded from PPO (MaskedPPO) and earn the learner nothing; evaluation never uses prefixes.

mass_randomization_provenance.basis: robin via laptop 2026-10-16 16:26:40Z: 'keep mass robust, we can have this much difference'; measured arm ~0.80 kg assembled vs 0.682 kg nominal; custom gripper of unknown mass
mass_randomization_provenance.note: whole-arm scale 0.9-1.4 x nominal, times an independent 0.7-1.6 on wrist, gripper and jaw (robust stage only). Gripper-floor friction is not randomized independently yet (materials are per shape here).
